# Edviro

> Edviro brings AI into building operations. It pulls together the data scattered across bills, meters, BMS, work orders, and sensors, catches energy waste as it starts, fixes it, and proves the savings with audit-grade measurement and verification (M&V). All of that data compounds into a digital twin of each building, used for capital planning and intervention simulation. Backed by Y Combinator.

## What Edviro does

Utility tracking and monitoring tools stop at charts. Edviro is the execution layer that closes the loop:

- Ingest: connect data scattered across bills, meters, weather, tariffs, BMS, work orders, and sensors into one live model. Nothing to rip out.
- Detect: learn each building's normal load, schedules, and equipment, then flag drift, anomalies, and waste in real time.
- Act: raise work orders, guide facilities teams in the app, and adjust setpoints and schedules, after testing each change first.
- Verify: confirm every change in the meter data and on the utility bill with audit-grade M&V.

## Digital twin and capital planning

Everything Edviro ingests and every fix it verifies builds a living digital twin of each building. Facilities teams use it to simulate interventions before spending money — replace a boiler versus keep tuning it, add a new wing, change a schedule, absorb a rate change — and rank capital projects by modeled payback from their own data, then verify results after funding.

## Who it is for

- School facilities and K-12 districts: continuous energy audits, automatic fault detection, work orders, and capital plans backed by modeled payback for budget and bond season.
- Commercial real estate and offices: occupancy-aware HVAC and lighting using existing WiFi routers, cutting energy and peak demand charges, with capex ranked by payback across the portfolio.
- Construction teams: independent baselining and audit-grade M&V built into the build, with the as-built digital twin checked against the design model.
